summary: KOA page + booking form: $53 (back-in FHU, Nov 2026) to $249, open all year (limited Dec 14-Mar 10), 140 sites, 70 ft, 50A, laundry/store/Wi-Fi, 10% military; W/E sites capped 12-15 ft. Branson gateway 6 km lifts the gate; Google 4.4 (659).
flags: PRICE GATE: cheapest night a 23-ft motorhome can book is $53 before tax (back-in full hookup, Tue 2026-11-17; $63 Mar 2027, $65 Jul 2027), over $50, but Branson is a gateway 6 km away (gateways.py, as in inclusion_evidence), so the gate is lifted. Google Maps 4.4 from 659 reviews; RV Life 4.5. The $53 type reads 'Requires leveling, No slides'.

FIT NOTE: KOA's water/electric site types reject a 23-ft rig ('over the 12 ft maximum length' pull-thru, '15 ft' back-in; described 'Best for vans, pop-ups or truck campers'), so the base is the full-hookup back-in.
